title: Songkran Festival
metaDescription: Songkran Festival: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Tradition.

overview.about: Songkran is the Thai New Year, celebrated each April with the world's biggest water fight - a joyful nationwide soaking that symbolises washing away the old year. Alongside the street water battles, it is a deeply traditional family and temple festival, and it was added to UNESCO's heritage list in 2023.
overview.nextEvent: The next Songkran runs 13-15 April across Thailand, with Bangkok and Chiang Mai hosting the largest celebrations. Expect city-wide water fights by day and temple visits, processions and family gatherings alongside them.
